bio.name: Abraar Jihaad H.
bio.title: Software Engineer
bio.bio: Software engineer with 1+ years of experience across mobile and AI engineering. Built mobile applications and AI-powered systems with a focus on practical and scalable products.

projects.title: K-sini: Indoor Navigation iOS App
projects.description: Built an indoor navigation iOS app for train stations in a cross-functional team at Apple Developer Academy. Rendered GeoJSON-driven multi-floor maps as layered MapKit overlays, with BFS shortest-path routing and compass-guided haptic feedback. Shipped a working app that guides passengers eyes-free across station floors.
projects.short_description: Built an indoor navigation iOS app for train stations, covering multi-floor MapKit mapping, BFS routing, and eyes-free haptic guidance. Shipped a working app with a cross-functional team at Apple Developer Academy.

projects.title: Kriptoin: Crypto Trading Simulation App
projects.description: Developed a risk-free cryptocurrency trading simulation app in Flutter. Pulled real-time market data from the CoinGecko API through a Hive caching layer, adding SHA-256 password hashing, fingerprint biometric login, and 7 coordinated Provider state managers. Delivered a fully functional trading simulator end to end.
projects.short_description: Developed a risk-free crypto trading simulator in Flutter with real-time CoinGecko market data, biometric login, and offline caching. Delivered a complete, working product end to end.

projects.title: PixPlay: Cloud-Based Music Player
projects.description: Built a cloud-based music player with a React frontend and an Express.js REST API in MVC. Used Sequelize over MySQL, JWT authentication with refresh-token cookies, and a Cloud Build CI/CD pipeline deploying Docker images to Cloud Run. Achieved fully automated, repeatable deployments on every push.
projects.short_description: Built a cloud-based music player with a React frontend, Express.js API, and JWT auth over MySQL. Achieved fully automated Docker deployments to Cloud Run on every push.

projects.title: ML for Earthquake Classification — Undergraduate Thesis
projects.description: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline classifying 2,800+ seismic events for my undergraduate thesis. Processed waveforms with ObsPy, used a CNN autoencoder with a custom multi-domain loss as an unsupervised feature extractor, and classified with XGBoost. Improved classification accuracy from 90% to 98%.
projects.short_description: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline classifying 2,800+ seismic events for my undergraduate thesis. Improved classification accuracy from 90% to 98%.

projects.title: SIGAP: AI News Analysis Web App
projects.description: Built an AI news analysis web app for Indonesian news portals. Scraped articles with BeautifulSoup and Selenium into SQLite via SQLAlchemy, then ran a locally hosted Llama 3.2 (Ollama) pipeline that summarizes each article and generates solutions. Processed 1,000+ articles monthly.
projects.short_description: Built an AI news analysis web app that scrapes Indonesian portals and summarizes them with a locally hosted Llama 3.2 pipeline. Processes 1,000+ articles monthly.

projects.title: Air Quality Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed the Beijing Station air quality dataset end to end. Used Python with Pandas to clean, explore, and visualize the station's measurement parameters. Extracted the dataset's pollution patterns and trends into a comprehensive analysis.
projects.short_description: Analyzed the Beijing Station air quality dataset with Python and Pandas. Extracted the dataset's pollution patterns and trends into a comprehensive analysis.

Completed Google's academy in machine learning, mobile development, and cloud computing. Graduated with Distinction, ranked among the top 10% of the cohort.
Built the backend for a web-based news scraping system with LLM-powered analysis. Developed FastAPI endpoints and AI pipeline that processed 1,000+ articles monthly.
Automated registration validation, certificate generation, and acceptance emails with Google Apps Script. Cut a three-person workflow down to one person, handling around 50 registrants per day.
